Hi Sanjay,

Thanks again for agreeing to be a product reference after last week's demo — really appreciate you and the Acme team jumping in. As a small token of appreciation we typically offer one of the following: a $1,000 platform credit applied to your account, a curated swag kit shipped to a contact of your choice, or a donation to a charity of your choice (we can provide a donation receipt).

Could you confirm which option you prefer? If donation: please let us know the charity name and whether you need a formal donation receipt and VAT information for Acme. If swag: share the shipping address and contact name. If credit: tell me the account email to apply the credit to.

If helpful, I can loop in ops/finance to expedite receipts and shipping.

Best,
